name: Vanessa
source:
Child prodigy turned doctor, Vanessa is as smart as she is beautiful. Graduating from Med School at a record young age for her state, Vanessa soon specialized and set up her own practice.

As an Urologist, Vanessa is an expert in, and takes special care of, the sexual health of her patients.

Offering unique one-on-one treatment, Vanessa’s philosophy is total care from admission to discharge. Vanessa’s desire is to help in any way possible, her drive to make people’s lives better in any way she can.

And Dr. Vanessa has a deep appreciation for the sexual drive burning in all humans. Desire is healthy and natural, and part of her care package is to assist her patients to explore these wants in the safety and privacy of her clinic.

[From [url=https://www.dumbkoala.art/MeetTheCast/info.php?name=Vanessa]DumbKoala[/url]]
